components.name: Footer
components.summary: Use Footer at the bottom of every page.

components.name: SearchBar
components.summary: Use SearchBar in the header and in the homepage banner.

components.name: OrderInfoBar
components.summary: Use OrderInfoBar directly below add-to-cart on a PDP.

components.name: OrderSummary
components.summary: Use OrderSummary on the cart page and in checkout.

components.name: PdpGallery
components.summary: Use PdpGallery as the left column of a PDP.

components.name: ProductInfoTable
components.summary: Use ProductInfoTable inside the PDP's "Eigenschaften" panel.

components.name: ProductTile
components.summary: Use ProductTile for every product in a listing, a carousel rail, or a related-products block.

components.name: BlogCard
components.summary: Use BlogCard wherever an article is teased: in the blog archive, in the sidebar, and inside ArticleRow on shop pages.

components.name: ArticleRow
components.summary: Use ArticleRow to tease articles outside the magazine: on the homepage, on a category page, at the end of an article.

components.name: IconList
components.summary: Use IconList for a short set of facts about uWeed or a brand: the "why uWeed" band on the homepage or a category page, the facts on a brand page, and the band…

components.name: NewsletterBlock
components.summary: Use NewsletterBlock to invite a visitor to the newsletter: on the homepage, at the end of a blog article, or above the footer.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Use Badge for a small label that classifies, counts or flags something.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Use Button for anything that performs an action or navigates; the variant is chosen by purpose, never by how much attention you want it to have.

components.name: Card
components.summary: Use Card as the shared surface under tiles, panels and grouped blocks — not usually as a component you place by itself.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Use Icon wherever the interface needs an icon: the order info bar, messages, chevrons in navigation, cart and favourites controls.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: The approved uWeed logo kit (August 2026): a horizontal logo, the same logo with the tagline, and the mark, each as a ready-coloured SVG, plus two favicon PNGs.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Use Link for navigation; pick the variant by whether the link has to announce itself, not by where it sits.

components.name: Price
components.summary: Use Price for any price, anywhere.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Use Accordion + AccordionItem for FAQ blocks, PDP tabs on mobile and category text.

components.name: ContentTabs
components.summary: Use ContentTabs for the product page sections (description, specifications, ingredients, use, storage, safety) from 992px (bs-breakpoint-lg) up.

components.name: FilterPill
components.summary: Use FilterPill for every facet trigger — one per facet, always visible.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Use Popover for any panel that opens from a trigger and floats above the page.

components.name: SortButton
components.summary: Use SortButton as the sort control on a listing.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Use Tooltip only for nuance the reader could do without.

components.name: Message
components.summary: Use Message for feedback the reader must be able to come back to — form errors, compliance notes, coupon results, shipping notices.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Use Skeleton where the incoming shape is known — a reloading product grid, cart drawer rows, filter results.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Use Spinner when you cannot know the shape of what is coming — a submitting form, an in-flight request.

components.name: StockStatus
components.summary: Use StockStatus on a PDP below the variation selector.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: Use Checkbox for independent on/off and for filter facets.

components.name: CouponForm
components.summary: Use CouponForm on the cart page, in the cart drawer and at checkout.

components.name: FormField
components.summary: Use FormField around every form control.

components.name: Input
components.summary: Use Input for any text entry.

components.name: QuantitySelector
components.summary: Use QuantitySelector wherever a quantity is set or shown.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: Use RadioGroup + Radio for any single-choice set.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Use Select for one-of-many where the list is known.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Use Breadcrumb above the H1 on category and product pages.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: Use Carousel for a horizontal rail of products or city tiles.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Use Pagination below a product grid or blog archive.

components.name: TabNav
components.summary: Use TabNav for one axis of category filtering above a grid or a rail.

components.name: AgeGate
components.summary: Use AgeGate as the first thing a visitor sees.

components.name: CartDrawer
components.summary: Use CartDrawer for the slide-in cart.

components.name: FilterPanel
components.summary: Use FilterPanel for filtering and sorting a product listing below lg, where the row of filter pills has no room.

components.name: Modal
components.summary: Use Modal for three things only: the age gate (AgeGate), login from the header account icon, and confirming a deletion.

components.name: ColourPairings
components.summary: Approved text and background pairs, and the ones that fail.

components.name: Colours
components.summary: The palette by family: each family has one job.

components.name: ContentTable
components.summary: A multi-column table for editorial content: comparisons, reference data, specs and figures inside blog articles and category pages.

components.name: Imagery
components.summary: Category images and partner logos: canvas, framing and display (November 2026).

components.name: MotionAndStacking
components.summary: Three durations and one easing; eleven stacking tokens.

components.name: ProductListing
components.summary: A category page (PLP) built from this system's components: the page to copy when you build a listing.

components.name: ShopPrototype
components.summary: A clickable mock of the uweed.ch shop, built only from this design system's components.

components.name: SpacingAndShape
components.summary: The spacing scale in use, radius, border widths and elevation.

components.name: Typography
components.summary: Poppins for headings, DM Sans for everything else, fluid between 375 and 1280px.

components.name: VerticalColours
components.summary: Five shop verticals, one colour family each, for category imagery and creative assets (proposed, November 2026).
